summary: Atmus Filtration Technologies filed an 8-K on 2026-11-06 reporting third-quarter 2026 results and disclosing that its board approved a new share repurchase authorization of up to $300 million of common stock, effective immediately. The new program replaces the prior authorization, which had $28.9 million remaining. Repurchases may occur in the open market or privately negotiated transactions, including Rule 10b5-1 plans, funded from operating cash and cash on hand; no expiration date, no obligation to buy, suspendable at any time. The prior buyback's unused capacity was effectively retired. Watch pace of execution versus prior residual authorization and any signal on share-price view.
